create_Color_object: create a Color object from a web color name like 'blue' or hex string '#00f'
convert_hsl2rgb: convert an HSL color tuple to RGB using the hsl2rgb function
convert_rgb2hex: convert an RGB tuple of floats to a hex color string using rgb2hex
convert_hex2rgb: convert a hex color string like '#ff0000' to an RGB tuple using hex2rgb
lighten_webcolor: lighten or darken a web color by a fraction using the lighten_webcolor function
